issues: BLOCKER: The paste blocks in docs/cis-fix/batch-7.md do not have the required first line. The ```bash block with `sudo bash ~/cis-audit/batch-7.sh` is PASTE 1 and has no `# RUNS ON: JOHNNY (SSH)` first line. PASTE 2 (`sudo bash ~/cis-audit/batch-7.sh 2`) is only mentioned in prose and has no fenced block at all. It needs its own numbered block starting with `# RUNS ON: JOHNNY (KVM)`, followed by `# RUNS IN: KVM`. The `# RUNS ON` comments that exist sit inside batch-7.sh, which is not what AJ copies or types. Fix: make each fenced block's line 1 `# RUNS ON: JOHNNY (SSH)` / `# RUNS ON: JOHNNY (KVM)` and line 2 `# RUNS IN: ...`. Also label the scp block `# RUNS ON: LAPTOP` and add it as a pre-step, since it is not a Johnny paste.

Everything else I checked is sound. Safe direction: every failure mode I found stops the script rather than risking the SSH session. Not a BLOCKER: the sshd [::]:22 socket stays bound and 0.0.0.0:22 is verified before and after the change. There is no GRUB, initrd or reboot change. The backup is written before the edit and kept across reruns. The sysctl change reverts itself if IPv4 SSH is lost. The repo copies etc/netplan/00-installer-config.yaml (no dhcp6: true) and etc/ufw/sysctl.conf (no disable_ipv6 override) match what the script assumes. etc/sysctl.d/60-johnny-cis-network.conf is also in the repo, which I did not read.

Nit: the auto-revert after a failed IPv4 check sets the live keys back to 0 but leaves the two lines appended to 60-johnny-cis-network.conf. A reboot would re-apply them. The ## Rollback section covers it, but the STOP-ipv4-ssh message could say to run the rollback block.

Nit: persistence is not verified. Nothing checks that no later sysctl.d file overrides disable_ipv6 at boot. I found none in the repo copies. Consider running `sysctl --system 2>&1 | grep disable_ipv6` in the verify block, or confirming at the post-batch re-audit.
Nit: under pipefail, `ss ... | awk ... | grep -qx` can false-fail on SIGPIPE. That would give a spurious STOP-no-v4-ssh. It fails safe, and rerunning fixes it.

Nit: AGENTS.md says repo copies under etc/ update in the same commit. Add the new etc/systemd/system/ssh.socket.d/60-johnny-cis-ipv4.conf and the updated etc/sysctl.d/60-johnny-cis-network.conf after the run.
